newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain int'l call prices to be cut 8.8 pct March 15.
newsitem.headline: Spain int'l call prices to be cut 8.8 pct March 15.

text.p: A average cut of 8.8 percent in Spain's international telephone charges will take effect from midnight on Friday, Telefonica de Espana said.
The firm approved the cut in foreign calls in February.
Calls to the United States will now cost 85.1 pesetas per minute standard rate, down from 99.1 pesetas and cheap rate will be 65 pesetas per minute, down from 79.9.
Telefonica said international phone tariffs have fallen by around 20 percent in the past year.
